svg.title: raid-chunk-grid-dimension-brackets-pointers
svg.desc: 4-device chunk-slot grid (one row per device), each row opening with a zigzag 'already used' mark and one highlighted write cell; Chunk / ZRWA-half / ZRWA double-headed dimension brackets label the column spans above, colour-coded triangle pointers mark each write's landing column below, and a dashed elbow arrow routes one device's pointer to another device's parity cell | source: asplos25-028_fig4 (asplos25-028_fig4_p7_vector.svg) | candidate wave4:raid-chunk-grid-dimension-brackets-pointers | units: pt at print size | colours as drawn, recolour by role
